verdict.rationale: Deel documents two credential types, API tokens and OAuth2 [deel-docs-27]. OAuth2 is described as letting an app access 'specific data' with explicit user consent [deel-docs-28], and the MCP server uses an OAuth2 authorization flow for agent clients [deel-docs-17], which implies some ability to limit agent access. However, the evidence never documents permission scopes, per-token restrictions, or how to issue an agent-specific least-privilege credential. Missing for 10: documented scope list or granular permission model, ability to restrict API tokens to specific resources or read-only access, agent-specific credential issuance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
